title: The burning of Fort Dearborn on the public site
items: The home page, Jaunts and 1812 pages show new films of Fort Dearborn burning on 16 August 1812: the brands going in at the gate, the roofs ablaze, the fort from across the river and the roofs falling in.
The home page plays its moving town background again, and shows how a source travels from the archive to the street you walk.
